Genetically engineered Marines travel throughout Space, battling depraved heretics, dishonourable traitors, and vile aliens.

This set includes 4 powered gauntlets, two holding the torn off heads of two different types of alien beast - a brutal ork, and a sinister soulstealer. The third holds a retro style space beaky helmet, and the fourth is empty, perhaps for you to add in your own head model! All four have supported versions.

This is an updated version of the first thing I ever tried to 'sculpt', as opposed to arrange geometric shapes - an ork head. It's a little reflection on my part, comparing where I started to where I am. It's been a slow process, as I take what digital hobby time I can in between physical modelling and all my other fickle interests! But it's still nice to see what I feel in some improvement.

You can see the original here:
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/power-gauntlet-prime-scale-powered-gauntlet-holding-head

I am an amateur enthusiast 3D designer, and appreciate all constructive feedback. Please check out my other designs for more wargame models, and please consider following me, posting a make, or even leaving a donation via my profile!

"Suported Dwarf The Second by Dopaminis" by Leighbar: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4424041

While looking for a Troll Slayer to use in Warhammer Quest I found this great Demon Slayer model, which Leighbar has rescaled and supported. Unfortunately the original seems have disapeared along with its creator. I have used meshmixer to remove the supports to restore the original version so you can support it yourself and rescale it freely.

Leigabar notes their version was "scaled down by +/- 8% so he would be on par with WizKids Nolzur's and DeepCuts minis."
I have kept it at that scale so if you want the original size you'll need to scale it back up to ~108.7%.

<b>You can download updates and pre-supported version here: </b> https://cults3d.com/en/users/TopoSolitarioCrafts/creations

"El TOPO" is a miniature for the world of INFINITY (the game) that dates back to 2007, when Corvus Belli's Infinity was still young, there were no 3D printing (not even for production masters) and the forums were starting to be active with just a bunch of guys in the spanish community.

El Topo was first found in Carlos Bostria's comic strips about the game. Later in 2008 I modeled (classic modelling with green stuff) a version of the miniature which was produced in very small quantity.
Now, this is actually my second try on creating a miniature with ZBrush, and I'm happy with the results, so you can get it for free!

Enjoy having a chubby mercenary in your ranks!
